goal: One sentence: what the programme delivers and how the owner will know.

authority.note: This registry says who may write where and which tasks each lane carries. It promotes no task state.

machine.notes: Disk, simulator, device, licence or cache constraints that every lane must respect.

stages.unit: <command that runs the unit suites and prints an executed count>

checkpoints.name: Clean page
checkpoints.exit: Roadmap, registry, board, briefs and validator on main; owner paths overlap-free; build and worktree roots fixed.

checkpoints.name: First slices
checkpoints.exit: Every active lane has one vertical slice merged through the integrator; unit suites pass with zero skips.

checkpoints.name: Journeys
checkpoints.exit: End-to-end behaviour verified by integration suites; manifests applied once.

checkpoints.name: Candidate
checkpoints.exit: Every in-scope task SOURCE_READY at one SHA; release artifact produced and inspected.

lanes.name: Coordination, arbitration and the programme record
lanes.branch: main (writes only the plan and the record; never source)
mutexes: Writes no production source, runs no build or test, merges no branch, promotes no state. It owns the map, not the territory.

checkpointDeliverables.CP0: Coordination model documented; decisions log opened; roster carries every agent.
checkpointDeliverables.CP1: Open questions and conflicts answered mid-phase; briefs reconciled; readiness call before the integrator closes CP1.

lanes.name: Integration, verification and shared mutexes
lanes.branch: main (merges lane/* branches; no feature branch of its own)
mutexes: The only agent that runs a stage, merges into main, applies a manifest, edits a shared file it owns, or promotes a canonical state.

checkpointDeliverables.CP0: This plan on main; roots verified; gates stage run.
checkpointDeliverables.CP1: Lanes merged serially; unit stage run; changelog entry; lanes told to rebase.
